§6Plutonium-238§f

§aThe hot one. Glows from heat, powers RTG generators for over a year.§f

Pu-238 is primarily obtained by breeding. It visibly glows from incandescence and is most useful as §bRTG fuel pellets§f.

Properties: §e10.0§f RAD/s radioactivity, §e33.3%§f of raw plutonium.

Main use is the §bRTG Pellet§f: §e10§f HE/tick. With decay enabled, each pellet lasts §e631M§f ticks (over 1 real year, 131 in-game years) producing §e6.3B§f HE total. They decay to lead.

Other uses: RT Generator, RTG Blast Furnace, Minigun crafting, Pu238Be RBMK Neutron Source, Radio Isotope Cell, Self-Charging Battery (100 HE/tick), breeding Pu-239, and contributes §e1.15§f to the custom nuke.

Right-clicking with a pellet spouts random nuclear science facts.

§ePS:§f Stack Pu-238 pellets in an RT Generator for maintenance-free passive power.
